BRAND & THEME CONSTRAINTS:
- Primary Brand Color: Deep Teal (#0F766E) and mint tones (#E6F4F1, #CCECE6).
- Strictly Light Theme with soft mint wash backgrounds (#F4FAF8 / #F8FAFC) and crisp white cards (#FFFFFF).
- Typography: Plus Jakarta Sans. No emojis anywhere (use clean Material Symbols or minimal SVG icons).
- Design system: Precision Geospatial Analytics (DESIGN_SYSTEM_1).

CHROME & SHELL (matches existing GeoLens screens SCREEN_5, SCREEN_7, SCREEN_8, SCREEN_9, SCREEN_10, SCREEN_13):
- SideNavBar (Left Sidebar, fixed width w-64):
  - Brand header: GeoLens logo with teal badge 'v2.4', subtext 'Spatial & Search AI'.
  - Primary CTA button: '+ New Analysis' (solid teal button).
  - Navigation Sections:
    * AI ANALYSIS:
      - Visibility Overview
      - Competitor Research (with badge '5')
      - Prompt Research
    * BRAND PERFORMANCE:
      - Brand Performance
      - Perception & Sentiment
      - Fact-checking (ACTIVE state: highlighted teal container with indicator dot, bold teal text)
    * BOOST & MONITOR:
      - Prompt Tracking (with badge 'LIVE')
      - Sources & Citations
      - Actions & Fixes
  - Sidebar bottom footer: Monthly AI Crawl Quota progress widget (28.4%, 1,420 / 5,000 queries, Manage link), followed by Documentation, Support, Settings links.
- TopNavBar (Top Header):
  - Left: Account switcher dropdown 'Attio · Demo', breadcrumb separator, 'AI Visibility Suite' / 'Fact-checking'.
  - Center/Right controls:
    * Time range pills: 'Last 7 days' (active), 'Last 30 days', '90 days'.
    * Model filter dropdown: 'All Models (4 Engines)'.
    * Trial status badge: '14 days left in trial' with 'Upgrade' link.
    * Actions: 'Export Audit Report' (outline button with download icon), '+ New Analysis' or '+ Add Asserted Fact' quick CTA.
    * Utility icons: Notifications (bell with ping), Telemetry tuning, Help, User avatar ('AL').

MAIN WORKSPACE CONTENT — Fact-checking:
1. Header Section:
   - Breadcrumbs: 'AI VISIBILITY SUITE > BRAND PERFORMANCE > FACT-CHECKING'.
   - Page Title: 'Fact-checking' with an adjacent status badge: 'Claims Audit · Grounding Telemetry' (soft mint pill with teal live dot).
   - Right Actions: 'Saved Views' button, 'Share Audit' button, and a solid primary teal action button 'Run Verbatim Audit'.
   - Subtitle: 'Claims from AI chats judged against your asserted facts — audit where LLMs contradict official specifications, pricing, or compliance benchmarks.'

2. KPI Metric Cards (4 cards grid across top):
   - Card 1: 'Claims Reviewed' -> Value: '1,420' with pill '+18% vs last crawl' (teal), subtext 'Extracted from 280 prompt runs'.
   - Card 2: 'Contradictions Detected' -> Value: '14' (high alert amber/rose accent #DC2626 / #EF4444 or burnt orange/amber #D97706), with badge 'Immediate Action Needed', subtext 'Across 3 foundation models'.
   - Card 3: 'Supported & Grounded' -> Value: '1,286' (90.6%) with badge 'Verified Accurate' (emerald/teal #0F766E), subtext '100% matched to documentation'.
   - Card 4: 'Unverified / Ambiguous' -> Value: '120' (8.4%) with badge 'Needs Grounding Source', subtext 'Missing authoritative anchor URL'.

3. Filter & Action Toolbar:
   - Search input: 'Search claims by entity, keyword, or model output...'
   - Filter dropdowns: 'Severity: High (Contradictions)', 'Model: All 4 Engines', 'Status: Contradicts & Unverified'.
   - Quick tabs/pills: 'All Claims (1,420)', 'Contradictions (14)', 'Unverified (120)', 'Supported (1,286)'.
   - Primary Action CTA: '+ Add Asserted Fact' (solid teal button with plus icon).
   - Secondary Bulk Actions: 'Export CSV', 'Mark Triaged'.

4. Split Workspace Layout (Two-Column Layout: Left ~38%, Right ~62%):
   - LEFT COLUMN: 'Asserted Facts Repository' (Your Ground Truth):
     * Header with count: 'Asserted Truths (8 Active Benchmarks)' and 'Filter by Category (Pricing, Compliance, Architecture)'.
     * Fact Item 1 (Selected/Active):
       - Category Pill: 'PRICING & TIERS'
       - Fact Statement: 'Attio offers a Free tier up to 3 seats; Pro plan starts at $29/seat/mo billed annually. Enterprise pricing is custom with dedicated SLAs.'
       - Grounding Source: 'attio.com/pricing' (with link icon and last verified date 'Oct 24, 2025')
       - Telemetry: '3 Contradictions detected in Perplexity & ChatGPT-4o'.
     * Fact Item 2:
       - Category Pill: 'SECURITY & COMPLIANCE'
       - Fact Statement: 'SOC 2 Type II certified annually since November 2023. HIPAA compliance eligible on Enterprise plan.'
       - Grounding Source: 'attio.com/security'
       - Telemetry: '5 Contradictions detected (LLMs citing deprecated 2022 draft).'
     * Fact Item 3:
       - Category Pill: 'DATA MODEL'
       - Fact Statement: 'Native relational architecture supports custom objects, multi-parent relations, and bi-directional record sync.'
       - Grounding Source: 'attio.com/docs/relational-model'
       - Telemetry: '412 Supported claims, 0 Contradictions.'
     * Fact Item 4:
       - Category Pill: 'INTEGRATIONS'
       - Fact Statement: 'Full GraphQL API with 10,000 req/min rate limit and native webhooks for real-time CRM updates.'
       - Grounding Source: 'attio.com/developers'
       - Telemetry: '2 Unverified mentions.'

   - RIGHT COLUMN: 'AI Claim Feed & Telemetry Audit' (What LLMs are actively outputting):
     * Filter header: 'Evaluated AI Claims (14 Flagged Contradictions & Recent Runs)' with model badges.
     * Claim Card 1 (Contradiction Alert):
       - Top Bar: Engine Pill 'Perplexity Pro' (sonar-large), Query: 'How much does Attio enterprise cost and does it have a free trial?'
       - Status Badge: 'Contradicts Asserted Fact' (soft rose container, dark crimson text, exclamation icon).
       - Verbatim AI Output Excerpt:
         '\"Attio does not offer a public free tier for teams; enterprise plans require bespoke quotes starting at an estimated $1,200/month flat fee according to recent G2 discussions.\" '
       - Discrepancy Analysis Box (mint/neutral alert panel):
         * Asserted Fact: 'Free tier up to 3 seats; Pro is $29/seat/mo.'
         * Root Cause: Perplexity synthesized unverified forum chatter rather than /pricing schema.
       - Action Row: 'Open Fix Blueprint' (teal CTA), 'Push Correction to Knowledge Base', 'Inspect Raw Chat Telemetry', and 'Mark Resolved'.
     * Claim Card 2 (Contradiction Alert):
       - Top Bar: Engine Pill 'ChatGPT-4o', Query: 'Is Attio SOC2 Type II compliant for healthcare fintech data?'
       - Status Badge: 'Contradicts Asserted Fact' (red/rose alert).
       - Verbatim AI Output:
         '\"As of early 2024, Attio has completed SOC 2 Type I and is currently undergoing auditing for Type II certification.\" '
       - Discrepancy Analysis Box:
         * Asserted Fact: 'SOC 2 Type II certified annually since November 2023.'
         * Impact: Enterprise procurement barrier in 14 tracked buyer prompts.
       - Action Row: 'Open Fix Blueprint', 'Inject Authoritative Security Schema', 'Inspect Raw Chat'.
     * Claim Card 3 (Supported & Grounded Example):
       - Top Bar: Engine Pill 'Google AI Overviews', Query: 'Which CRM has native relational custom objects and GraphQL?'
       - Status Badge: 'Supported & Grounded' (soft teal/mint pill, deep teal check icon).
       - Verbatim AI Output:
         '\"Attio features a built-in relational database model supporting custom objects and GraphQL APIs with real-time webhooks.\" '
       - Grounded Source Match: 'attio.com/docs/relational-model (100% confidence)'.
       - Action Row: 'View Source Citation', 'Inspect Grounding Index'.
     * Claim Card 4 (Unverified Claim):
       - Top Bar: Engine Pill 'Gemini 1.5 Pro', Query: 'Attio email sending limits for automated sequences'
       - Status Badge: 'Unverified / Ambiguous' (amber/yellow soft pill).
       - Verbatim AI Output:
         '\"Attio imposes a soft cap of 500 emails per day per seat on standard workspaces.\" '
       - Discrepancy: 'No asserted fact found in Attio documentation repository.'
       - Action Row: 'Add as Asserted Fact', 'Dismiss'.

Geospatial Analytics","styleGuidelines":"## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a high-density, analytical workspace engineered for spatial intelligence, enterprise location analysis, and competitive benchmarking. It targets enterprise strategists, data scientists, and operations executives who rely on swift pattern recognition across multi-layered geospatial datasets.

The aesthetic philosophy balances modern architectural restraint with high-functioning utilitarianism. By pairing crisp, structural neutrals with concentrated teal focal points, the interface creates an environment of calm focus and absolute precision. Every element communicates reliability, analytical rigor, and quiet confidence—deliberately avoiding decorative noise, gratuitous gradients, or dark-mode cognitive strain.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model utilizes a fluid 12-column analytical grid flanked by persistent floating control panels and interactive side inspectors. Spacing adheres to a strict 4px/8px modular cadence.

### Breakpoints & Adaptability
- **Desktop Wide (≥1440px)**: 12-column grid, fluid analytical viewport, 24px gutters, fixed-width tool rails (320px sidebar, 400px inspection pane).
- **Desktop/Laptop (1024px – 1439px)**: 12-column grid, 16px gutters, collapsible secondary drawer, map/chart area claims dominant flex-basis.
- **Tablet (768px – 1023px)**: 8-column layout, inspector panel converts into an absolute-positioned bottom sheet.
- **Mobile (<768px)**: Single-column flow with full-width horizontal-scroll cards, stacked key performance tiles, 16px outer safety margins.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy uses crisp, ambient low-blur drop shadows paired with fine boundary lines to maintain clarity across dense spatial layers. 

### Elevation Tiers
- **Tier 0 (Base Surface)**: `#F5F7F8` flat canvas, no shadow.
- **Tier 1 (Cards, Data Panels, Metrics)**: Pure `#FFFFFF`, `border: 1px solid #E3E9ED`, `box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.04), 0 1px 2px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.02)`.
- **Tier 2 (Hovered Cards, Dropdowns, Segment Popovers)**: `#FFFFFF`, `border: 1px solid #E3E9ED`, `box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.06), 0 2px 6px -1px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.03)`.
- **Tier 3 (Floating Map Controllers, Modals, Flyouts)**: `#FFFFFF`, `border: 1px solid #E3E9ED`, `box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -4px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.08), 0 4px 10px -2px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.04)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Action**: Solid `#0F766E` background, `#FFFFFF` bold text, 8px border radius, 0 1px 2px shadow. Hover: `#115E59`. Active: `#134E4A`.
- **Secondary Action**: `#FFFFFF` background, `#0B1218` text, 1px `#E3E9ED` border. Hover: `#F0FDF4` tint, border shifts to `#0F766E`.
- **Tertiary / Utility**: Ghost button with `#5C6B76` text. Hover: `#F5F7F8` fill, `#0B1218` text.

### Cards & Analytics Panels
- Standardized with pure `#FFFFFF` background, 12px or 16px corner radius, and 1px `#E3E9ED` perimeter stroke. 
- Headers feature uppercase `#5C6B76` micro-labels (`label-md`) coupled with large `#0B1218` numeric readouts.

### Chips & Filter Pills
- **Neutral State**: `#FFFFFF` background, 1px `#E3E9ED` border, `#5C6B76` text, 6px radius.
- **Active / Selected State**: `#ECFDF5` background, `#0F766E` text, 1px `#0F766E` border.

### Inputs & Controls
- **Text Inputs**: Height 36px/40px, pure `#FFFFFF` fill, 1px `#E3E9ED` border, 8px radius, `#0B1218` value text. Focus: 1px solid `#0F766E` with 2px `#ECFDF5` outer focus ring.
- **Checkboxes & Radios**: 16px square/round with 1px `#E3E9ED` border. Checked: `#0F766E` fill with `#FFFFFF` check/dot indicator.

### Data Tables & Geospatial Lists
- Alternating row interaction: Pure `#FFFFFF` resting, transitioning to `#F0FDF4` on pointer hover.
- Row separators: 1px solid `#E3E9ED`.
- Table head: `#F5F7F8` background with uppercase `label-md` tracking in `#5C6B76`.

## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a high-density, analytical workspace engineered for spatial intelligence, enterprise location analysis, and competitive benchmarking. It targets enterprise strategists, data scientists, and operations executives who rely on swift pattern recognition across multi-layered geospatial datasets.

The aesthetic philosophy balances modern architectural restraint with high-functioning utilitarianism. By pairing crisp, structural neutrals with concentrated teal focal points, the interface creates an environment of calm focus and absolute precision. Every element communicates reliability, analytical rigor, and quiet confidence—deliberately avoiding decorative noise, gratuitous gradients, or dark-mode cognitive strain.

## Colors

The palette operates under a strict single-mode light paradigm, utilizing cool atmospheric tones to maintain visual comfort across prolonged analytical sessions. Purple and indigo spectrums are strictly excluded across all interface layers and chart series.

### Semantic & Surface Structure
- **Canvas Root**: `#F5F7F8` serves as the structural floor, giving subtle framing to elevated data panes.
- **Surface Panels**: Pure `#FFFFFF` for primary cards, sidebars, floating inspectors, and modals.
- **Surface Wash & States**: `#F0FDF4` and `#ECFDF5` provide ambient status washes, hover fills, and selection containers.
- **Dividers & Structural Borders**: `#E3E9ED` delivers a crisp, low-weight separation layer.
